label: Google Agent Identity (fixture organisation)
source: The claim shape of a Google Agent Runtime agent's identity token validated live on Tue 10 Nov 2026 (specs/saas/identity-validation.md): RS256 from Google's Security Token Service path for the organisation's agent pool; iss, sub (the agent's SPIFFE id), aud (an array), exp, iat and an opaque google object; requested unbound, so no cnf. The issuer path and all ids are made up.
